1 Data Integrity & Leak-Free Test Isolation

During initial exploratory data analysis, 26 exact duplicate records (spanning 46 total rows) were identified. A naive random train/test split would cause identical rows to land across splits, severely contaminating the test set and artificially inflating generalization metrics.
